text:
Sophie: quick heads-up — platform is going to start attaching a routing/quota header to proxied requests next week, looks like it will be `X-RD-Route` with multiple semicolon-separated attrs. this might affect SDKs that strip unknown headers.
Kevin: can you paste the exact header format? trying to assess break surface for the python/ts sdks.
Jamal: format we're prototyping: `X-RD-Route: route=affinity:us-west;quota=team:payments;mode=best-effort` — order not guaranteed, values are k:v pairs. we also add `X-RD-Route-Version: 2`.
Linh: :thinking: console telemetry will need to read these for per-route dashboards; also rollout UX needs an opt-in toggle because product teams want to control attribution before we start attributing billing.
Sophie: agreed — plan is phased: 1) header emitted but ignored by default, 2) console toggle to opt-in teams for attribution, 3) SDKs implement a safe pass-through + opt-out sanitization.
Kevin: for SDKs what do we mean by "safe pass-through"? current node/python clients sanitize headers in our internal proxy stack. some corp proxies drop headers.
Jamal: safe pass-through = preserve header on outbound request to backend unless user explicitly set config to strip it. also SDKs should surface the `X-RD-Route-Version` so downstream SDK consumers can implement fallback logic.
Linh: UX asks — can we add a short migration banner in console when a team opts in? show how many requests will be re-attributed and a link to SDK changes.
Sophie: yes. also we need a backcompat window: SDKs should support v1 and v2 formats for 90 days after GA, log a warn-level message when v2 seen and SDK not configured to handle it.
Kevin: for breaking changes: python sdk will add `preserve_route_headers=True` default false to maintain current behavior. we'll ship minor semver bump and call it out in changelog. TS/Go we should do the same.
Jamal: ops note: routing policy may be used for quota evaluation soon; that means the control plane may start denying requests when team tag missing. we must ensure SDKs can opt-in to attach a fallback tag like `quota=unattributed` to avoid immediate failures.
Linh: can we make the console toggle default to "off" and provide a one-click opt-in with a dry-run mode that only shows how attribution would change? Product loves dry-run. :eyes:
Sophie: plan of record: 1) eng-platform finalizes header RFC by EOD Tue, 2) devex owners open SDK PR templates for python/ts/go by Fri, 3) console team builds opt-in + dry-run tile (beta) next sprint, 4) communicate to customers with migration guide and sample code.
Kevin: I'll open python/ts PRs. suggested changelog blurb: "Add opt-in support for Redwood routing headers (X-RD-Route, X-RD-Route-Version). Defaults preserve existing behavior; enable to opt into per-route quota attribution."
Jamal: I'll add server-side dry-run flag and make quota evaluation ignore unauthenticated route when dry-run=true.
Sophie: deploy-bot: CI pipeline note — rolling canary for header emit will run on the `route-header` feature flag yesterday->today. please watch `canary-routing` dashboard.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued: deploy/route-header/v2 -> canary cluster (run id: 2023175).
Linh: OK, action items captured. i'll draft the console banner copy and link to SDK PR templates once they're up. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Kevin: thumbs up, will tag you on PRs.
Sophie: closing — we'll reconvene in #devex next Thurs for pre-GA signoff.
